a) a parabolic approximation of the loss is sufficient to determine the step size for SGD in Deep Learning, and b) a parabolic fit over several mini-batch losses is a good approximation of the full-batches loss.
(1) the full-batch objective behaves parabolically in update directions and (2) the optimal update step sizes change slowly during training.

(1) a line search approach that approximates the loss with a parabolic model is a viable method for Deep Learning, and (2) the parabola is best estimated from several mini-batches, as it captures the noise in a better way than estimating it only from the current batch.
